dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped annular structures are visible. The three most prominent posterior rings feature a high-contrast white perimeter with a sharp gradient transition to a dark interior. The mid-dorsal region exhibits larger, overlapping annular structures with irregular, feathered edge geometries and lower contrast gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity white blobs, typically consisting of clusters of 1-5 pixels lacking internal gradients. These are primarily distributed within the interstitial spaces of the mid-dorsal annular clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct posterior-dorsal macro-annuli form a scalene triangle. The spatial relationship between this grouping and the centroid of the largest mid-dorsal annular cluster defines an irregular quadrilateral oriented along the longitudinal axis.
